more_info.overview: Ferrous hexacyanomanganate is listed as INS 537 in the 2008 Codex committee report, with an anti-caking function. The function concerns helping powdered ingredients remain free flowing. The historical list establishes the name and technological classification but does not provide a compound specification or typical retail-food example. It should not be assigned the chemistry or intake evaluation of the separately named ferrocyanide salts.
